full_name: Sarah E. James | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2020–2021 Arleen Carlson and Edna Nelson Graduate Fellow Harvard University
bio: Sarah E. James is a PhD candidate in social policy and government at Harvard University. Her research dissertation speaks to issues of state politics, race and inequality, bureaucratic capacity, policy feedback, the politicization of knowledge, and the role of data and research in policy making.
